name: import-linter-cooperative-contract-1a78
instr:
Import Linter cannot report deterministic contract progress or cooperatively cancel long evaluations while retaining completed results. Add controlled execution that exposes truthful algorithm work without changing lint outcomes or ordinary command behavior. `EvaluationEventKind` is a Enum.

Sequence events consecutively in configured contract order. Give every started contract exactly one completed, cancelled, or failed terminal event and an isolated graph. Each independent `CancellationToken`, exported from `importlinter`, accepts repeated `cancel` requests, reports them through `cancelled`, and shares no state.

Cancellation stops before further expensive work, searches, or importer queries. It omits an interrupted `ContractCheck`, retains completed checks, and prevents later contracts from starting. Report counts, callbacks, returned events, rendered and terminal progress, cancellation state, and final reports must agree on performed work, ordering, and terminal interpretation.

Across `ForbiddenContract`, `LayersContract`, `IndependenceContract`, `ProtectedContract`, and `AcyclicSiblingsContract`, expose every validation or preparation phase and each independently cancellable graph-search unit in deterministic algorithm order without changing uninterrupted results. Include configured forbidden-source searches after validation; optional, required, and container layer preparation before dependency analysis; and protected expressions followed by resolved top-level packages
